title: How New SPAC Music Acquisition Corp. Will Spend Its $230M IPO Money (Billboard)
notes: Billboard, Glenn Peoples, 2021-03-22. Music Acquisition Corp (MAC/TMAC) raised $230M in a Feb. 3, 2021 NYSE IPO; launched by ex-Geffen president Neil Jacobson + Todd Lowen; Jacobson also owns Hallwood Media; first music-specific SPAC. Top-tier corroboration of the ~$230M SPAC figure (was secondary-only in Q2.5). Caveat: SPAC filed to liquidate Oct 2022 without a de-SPAC.
